svg.title: How to use Guitoune
svg.desc: Guitoune tuner display with six string lanes (E2 to E4). The detected string is highlighted in green. The three vertical bars mark the tolerance window: minus 10 cents, correct, plus 10 cents. Six arrows link the lanes to the six guitar strings, from low pitch (top) to high pitch (bottom). Four numbered buttons are explained below the diagram: microphone, full screen, settings and colour theme.
svg.text: Play a string and read the display.

g.text: in green, in its own lane.
E2 to E4, top to bottom

svg.text: Turns listening on or off. The ring shifts from green to red
Enters or leaves full screen. Hidden on browsers that do not
support it, such as Safari on iPhone.
Opens a dialog with three options: the tuning (seven presets
such as Drop D or DADGAD), the reference pitch A4 (415–466 Hz)
and a fine scale (±15 cents instead of ±50).
Cycles through five colour themes: Dark, Light, Cappuccino,
Wood tones and Ocean. The choice is remembered.
